svg.title: Outbound
svg.desc: Page 4: Outbound. A card introduces Kaveri departing Baikal; Tomas reports readiness and Jonah gives the order. Kaveri departs. Baikal and the waiting Ebro recede behind it. No attack or pursuit appears.
